content: The community which has neither poverty nor riches will always have the noblest principles.
author: Plato
story:
There is a sharp, grounded clarity in this observation. We are conditioned to believe that more is always better—more possessions, more accomplishments, more stimulation. Yet our accumulation usually brings more anxiety, maintenance, and mental clutter.

Plato understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Wealth is not having endless things; it is wanting very little. When you realize that your deepest needs for peace, connection, and purpose cannot be bought, you become truly unshakeable.
reflectionPrompt: What would change in your daily outlook if you truly lived by this perspective?
